THE SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH — PipelineConfig: a plain @dataclass with 134 fields at src/scms_sim_ref/mock_pipeline/run.py:267-508 (verified count via dataclasses.fields). Groups auto-derived by name-prefix in _field_group (run.py:1097-1122): Run 9, Attacks 20, Mobility 35, GNSS/sensor 15, Detection/MA 20, Radio 13, Messages(DENM) 6, Network 11, RSU 4, Scenario events 1. Enum options in _ENUM_OPTIONS (run.py:1126-1136); per-field help/min/max/step/unit hand-maintained in _FIELD_META (run.py:1140-1330); tuple-typed fields listed in _TUPLE_FIELDS (run.py:1094). config_schema() (run.py:1333-1361) machine-generates {type, default, group, widget(bool|select|int|float|text), help, options, min, max, step, unit} for every field; test tests/test_config_io.py:67-80 enforces schema==all fields and JSON-safety. config_from_dict (run.py:1364-1391) rebuilds a config from a raw dict OR a manifest.json (nested "config" key), ignores unknown keys with a stderr warning (forward-compat), coerces list->tuple and element types (attacker_ids->int). validate_config (run.py:900-1090) fail-fasts on every enum/range/feature-dependency (e.g. lane_changes needs n_lanes>1 + traffic_flow run.py:954-958; gap_acceptance needs flow + non-linear net run.py:965-970; arterial caps rejected off grid/ring run.py:989-996; spider/custom require traffic_flow run.py:1057-1060) and clamps _PROB_FIELDS fractions (run.py:871-873, 1088-1089). Repo-wide convention: every new field's default must keep the default run byte-identical (opt-in, zero extra RNG when off) — stated repeatedly in field comments (e.g. run.py:437, 453-462, 392-399) and enforced by manifest-replay digest tests (tests/test_config_io.py:26-49).

CLI: run.py main() (run.py:3130-3394) hand-declares ~90 argparse flags (run.py:3140-3293) and hand-threads them into PipelineConfig(...) (run.py:3329-3389). Flag names sometimes diverge from field names (--denm-implausible-speed <- denm_implausible_speed_mps; --radio-range <- radio_range_m; --grid <- grid_w). Meta-flags: --config replays a saved config/manifest exactly (run.py:3282-3284, 3318-3328); --dump-config writes the effective config (run.py:3285, 3427-3432); --dump-config-schema writes config_schema() JSON and exits (run.py:3287-3288, 3312-3317); --check-config validates without running (run.py:3291, 3302-3311); --list-presets (run.py:3289, 3297-3301). --preset seeds parser defaults via two-phase parse + parser.set_defaults so explicit flags still win (run.py:3133-3136, 3294-3295). CLI_PRESETS (run.py:878-897; urban_rush/highway/night_rain/gridlock/stealth_hard) are keyed by ARGPARSE DESTS, not field names. Manifest capture: _write_manifest stores the full effective config (run.py:3111-3121), so every dataset is self-replaying.

gaps: Two disjoint config planes: the 134-field, schema'd, validated, manifest-captured, byte-replayable PipelineConfig drives ONLY the pure-Python engine; the MOSAIC/SUMO engine is configured by ~55 loose SCMS_* env vars + run.ps1 params (server.py:292-517, mapgen.py:113-172) with no schema endpoint, no validate_config, no manifest/config capture, no replay, and no copilot access. Realism features must currently be implemented twice or exist on one engine only (e.g. logdistance radio, VRUs, DENMs, events timeline, RSUs exist only python-flow; SUMO Krauss sigma/speedFactor, real netconvert networks exist only mosaic).

No engine abstraction seam for mobility: run_pipeline hardwires its own IDM/MOBIL/gap-acceptance integration in the step loop (only telemetry hooks at run.py:1401-1410 are injectable), so a SUMO/TraCI-backed traffic engine cannot be slotted under the existing SCMS/detector/MA/dataset layers without refactoring; the only practical hook today is a whole new top-level generator branch in server.start_run (server.py:675-679), which bypasses the python engine's entire detection stack.

Quadruple hand-maintained declaration for a curated knob: dataclass field (run.py:267-508) + _FIELD_META (run.py:1140-1330) + argparse flag and PipelineConfig(...) threading (run.py:3140-3389) + GUI CONFIG_SPEC pf_* entry (server.py:82-518). Parity is enforced only by tests (tests/test_gui_curated_knobs.py, test_config_io.py), not by construction; naming divergences (CLI drops _mps/_m suffixes; argparse dest != field) require the extra _DEST_TO_FIELD map (agent.py:412-416).

MOSAIC env knobs are silently unsafe: _envf falls back to default on any parse error (mapgen.py:113-118); GUI forwards any non-empty string (server.py:689-699); nothing validates SCMS_* values or records them in a run manifest, so MOSAIC datasets are not reproducible from recorded config.

Attack-model parity gap: the MOSAIC plane exposes 35 attack bases x profile/tier (~291 variants via SCMS_ATTACKS, server.py:58-77) while PipelineConfig uses its own attack_types catalog + intensity/mix/magnitude dials; a scenario cannot be expressed once and run on both engines.

Copilot interactivity caps (duration<=150s, n_steps<=200, sweep cap 90s; agent.py:35-36, 504) mean copilot-built corpora are short snapshots, not full-scale city runs; there is no 'hand off this config to a long background run' bridge from the agent to the GUI's uncapped start path.

Presets live in three unsynchronized places: GUI PRESETS (server.py:602-654), CLI_PRESETS (run.py:878-897, argparse-dest keyed), and the copilot consuming CLI_PRESETS via translation (agent.py:412-427); GUI presets can drift from CLI presets (they already differ in values, e.g. Urban rush arrival 3.0/grid 6 vs urban_rush arrival_rate 3.0/lanes 2).

Saved scenario library (saved_scenarios/*.json overrides) is reachable only through the copilot tools and GUI chat chips (agent.py:955-984, index.html:903-916); the curated form and the CLI cannot load a saved scenario (CLI --config wants a full config, not overrides).

The generated-map catalogue (68 real OSM cities + procedural nets, mapgen.py) exists only for the MOSAIC engine; the python engine's OSM import (osm.py, max_nodes=380 simplified graphs) is a separate, smaller-fidelity path — two different 'real city' sources with different geometry fidelity.
